title: 25章 乱世人心依如旧26章 骑荼过河心月归
lines: 灯火星星，人声杳杳，歌不尽乱世烽火。
乌云蔽月，人迹纷纷，说不出如斯慌乱。
生逢乱世，总有一群人会用他们自己的嶙峋傲骨支撑起了全社会的人格坐标，因此乱世也就获得了一种精神引渡。
但是此时匆匆而散的众人已被眼前这乱世的初露狰狞和血腥麻痹了心灵，马力和刘三的死亡好像一条虫子撞在一张蛛网上，激不起半点涟漪。
恍惚间，盛世歌舞还未停歇，乱世的马蹄也尚未踏响，却已经有人被鲜血逼迫长大。
张纯钧的落脚地显得甚是潦草，只有幼儿玩闹的小帐篷，只有幼儿在其中遮蔽夜间的寒气，而大人们则是围绕在四周看护，如今纵然是乱世，家中的幼儿仍是一家人的心头肉，容不得半点闪失。
纯钧之妻谢晓晓遥遥的看见纯钧回来，看到其狼狈的模样，以及惊骇的眼神，心中担心不已，可是看到张纯钧身旁的身影却是愣住了，半晌才道：“荼子？”
张荼点点头，但是心中却是颇为无奈，父母自是可以全然接受自己的异变，可是对于旁人来说，却是不亚于一场脱胎换骨，那本该模糊在记忆中的容颜，可是在十年后又清晰地呈现在众人面前，也难怪如此。
“嗯，是我。”张荼点点头，说道：“你们就住在这里？”
张纯钧这才从张荼方才暴虐的神态中缓过神来，说道：“不住在，住哪里？先住在这里，等待救援呗。”
在一阵寒暄中做落下，谢晓晓知道此时张荼来找纯钧，必定有事儿，所以接过奶粉后便是去安抚自己嗷嗷待哺的幼儿。
张荼开门见山地直接道：“要不要跟我走？”
叼着烟的张纯钧有些吊儿郎当，毫不在意地说道：“去哪？我家就在这，我还能去哪？”
“你车在哪呢？”张荼问道。
张纯钧说道：“在里面呢，别想了，出不来了，被堵死了。”指了指周围的人群说道：“你以为这些人为什么会留在这里呢？被那个狗屁东西所欺压，不过你也是真的狠，又没伤到我……”
张荼看着不沾丝毫血迹的双手，唯有衣袖上那星星点点的血迹，一时间无言，而就在这时，谢晓晓从张纯钧带回来的东西中，找出来一些简易的吃食，拿了过来。
“荼子？”谢晓晓喊道。
咬了咬嘴唇，谢晓晓依旧说道：“我听他们说，方才纯钧跟那伙人起了争执，然后……你……杀人了？”
语气中充满了不敢置信，可是从邻居绘声绘色的讲述中，谢晓晓又一阵万幸，万幸张荼的到来，要知道张纯钧可是他们家中的顶梁柱，是她娘俩的依靠，若是有个什么三长两短，生逢乱世，他们的家就塌了。
可尽管如此，都不能改变张荼那双手所沾染的鲜血，尤其是听邻里说的张荼行为的暴虐，让人不禁闻之心惊，对于生命的敬畏，让谢晓晓在事后有些不忍。
张荼接过吃食，面无表情，口中仍是淡淡的嗯了一声。
“谢谢啊。”
谢晓晓并不在意张荼的态度，口中踌躇地说道，在谢晓晓的思维之中，自己的家人才是第一位，至于其他，只有感激，对于生命的敬畏，也不过是在张纯钧无事之后的无聊感叹罢了，若当真张纯钧出了什么事儿，她不知道要怎么去面对。
张荼笑了，看到多少有一些畏惧的谢晓晓，说道：“嫂子，你这就见外了不是，我跟纯钧的感情，还用这就么客套么。”
张纯钧幽幽地说道：“你变化太大了，大到有种匪夷所思的感觉，以前的你不是这个样子的。”
张荼囫囵地持着东西，口中嘟囔着：“还不是被逼的？你看我这般做，有人敢过来说一句闲话不？播报你们也听到了，不像以前了，我如果扮可怜失手误杀也不是不可以，但是呢，还会有现在的情景么？”
“安啦，我知道你担心问兰太小，不适合奔波远行，等会儿……我让你看看什么叫作霸王扛鼎，把车搞出来，别吃了，带路。”
看着眼前横七竖八的巨大石块，在没有外力的情况，张荼仅凭着一双肉掌，却是干出了重工机械的效率，张纯钧以及抱着小问兰，在后面瞠目结舌地看着。
而有不少人，渐渐壮着胆子在后面看着围观凑热闹，可是看着道路一点点被清理出来，有不少人心中都热了起来，若是车子可以开出来，那谁愿意在这里干靠着呢，城市里，哪怕是亲人也住得天南地北的，而今代步工具可以弄出来，去寻找家人也是极好的。
“荼荼叔叔是奥特曼么？”问兰奶声奶气地问道。
张纯钧闻言不禁笑道：“对，你荼荼叔叔就是藏在你身边保护你的奥特曼。”
问兰不解地继续问道：“爸爸，可是为什么荼荼叔叔这么矮呢，奥特曼不都是比楼都要高的么？”
谢晓晓忍住笑，说道：“那是因为你荼荼叔叔还没有变身啊，你看，现在的荼荼叔叔是不是跟爸爸差不多高？”
content_en:
The lights are shining, the voices are dim, and the songs are endless, beacons of war in troubled times.
Dark clouds covered the moon, and there were many people everywhere. It was indescribable to be so confused.
In troubled times, there is always a group of people who will use their own rugged pride to support the personality coordinates of the whole society, so troubled times also gain a kind of spiritual extradition.
But at this time, the people who had dispersed in a hurry had been numbed by the first ferocious and bloody scenes of the troubled times. The deaths of Ma Li and Liu San were like a bug hitting a spider web, causing no ripples.
In a trance, the singing and dancing of the prosperous times have not yet stopped, and the horseshoes of the troubled times have not yet clattered, but there are already people who are forced to grow up by blood.
The place where Zhang Chunjun settled seemed to be very messy. There was only a small tent for children to play in, and only the children were sheltered from the cold night air, while the adults were around to take care of them. Even in troubled times, the children at home are still the heart and soul of the family, and there is no room for any mistakes.
Chunjun's wife, Xie Xiaoxiao, saw Chunjun coming back from a distance. Seeing his embarrassed appearance and horrified eyes, she was worried. However, when she saw the figure next to Zhang Chunjun, she was stunned. After a while, she said: "Tuzi?"
Zhang Tu nodded, but he felt quite helpless in his heart. His parents could fully accept his change, but to others, it was no less than a complete transformation. The face that should have been blurred in the memory was clearly visible to everyone ten years later. No wonder it was like this.
"Well, it's me." Zhang Tu nodded and said, "You guys live here?"
Zhang Chunjun finally recovered from Zhang Tu's violent demeanor and said, "If you don't live here, where can you live? Stay here first and wait for rescue."
After a while of greetings, Xie Xiaoxiao knew that there must be something wrong with Zhang Tu when he came to see Chunjun, so after receiving the milk powder, he went to comfort his baby who was waiting to be fed.
Zhang Tu said straight to the point: "Do you want to come with me?"
Zhang Chunjun, who was holding a cigarette in his mouth, was a little careless and said nonchalantly: "Where to go? My home is right here, where else can I go?"
"Where is your car?" Zhang Tu asked.
Zhang Chunjun said: "It's inside, don't think about it, you can't get out, it's blocked." He pointed to the crowd around him and said, "Why do you think these people stay here? They were bullied by that bullshit, but you were really cruel and didn't hurt me..."
Zhang Tu looked at his hands that were not stained with any blood, except for the dots of blood on his sleeves, and was speechless for a moment. At this moment, Xie Xiaoxiao found some simple food from what Zhang Chunjun brought back, and brought it over.
"Tuzi?" Xie Xiaoxiao shouted.
"Huh?"
Biting his lips, Xie Xiaoxiao still said: "I heard them say that just now Chunjun had a dispute with that group of people, and then...you...killed someone?"
The tone was full of disbelief, but from the neighbor's vivid narration, Xie Xiaoxiao felt lucky again. Fortunately for Zhang Tu's arrival, you must know that Zhang Chunjun is the backbone of their family and the support of her mother and father. If there is any shortcoming, their home will collapse in troubled times.
But despite this, it can't change the blood stained on Zhang Tu's hands, especially the cruelty of Zhang Tu's behavior heard from the neighbors, which makes people feel frightened. The reverence for life made Xie Xiaoxiao a little intolerable afterward.
"Yeah."
Zhang Tu took the food with an expressionless face, but still made a faint hum in his mouth.
"Thank you."
Xie Xiaoxiao didn't care about Zhang Tu's attitude, and said hesitantly that in Xie Xiaoxiao's mind, her family was the first priority. As for the rest, she only had gratitude and reverence for life, which was just a boring sigh after Zhang Chunjun was fine. If something really happened to Zhang Chunjun, she didn't know how to face it.
Zhang Tu smiled and saw Xie Xiaoxiao, who was somewhat frightened, and said, "Sister-in-law, you've just gone out on a limb, aren't you? The relationship between Chunjun and I is still so polite."
Zhang Chunjun said quietly: "You have changed so much, so much that it feels weird. You were not like this before."
Zhang Tu held the things tightly and muttered: "Aren't you forced? Look at me doing this, does anyone dare to come over and gossip? You have also heard the broadcast. It's not like before. It's not impossible if I pretend to be pitiful and accidentally kill someone. But, will the current situation still happen?"
"Okay, I know you're worried that Wenlan is too young to travel far away. Later... I'll show you what it means to be an overlord and carry a tripod. Get the car out, don't eat it, and lead the way."
Looking at the huge rocks lying in front of him, without any external force, Zhang Tu used only a pair of fleshy palms to do it with the efficiency of heavy industrial machinery. Zhang Chunjun and Xiao Wenlan were watching from behind with dumbfounded eyes.
Many people gradually gained the courage to watch from behind and join in the fun. But seeing the roads being cleared little by little, many people felt hot in their hearts. If cars could be driven out, who would be willing to work here? In the city, even relatives live in far and wide places. Now that transportation tools can be obtained, it is also great to go find family members.
"Is Uncle Tutu Ultraman?" Wenlan asked in a sweet voice.
Zhang Chunjun couldn't help but smile when he heard this: "Yes, your Uncle Tutu is the Ultraman hiding beside you to protect you."
Wenlan continued to ask in confusion: "Dad, why is Uncle Tutu so short? Aren't Ultramans taller than buildings?"
Xie Xiaoxiao held back her laughter and said, "That's because your Uncle Tutu hasn't transformed yet. Look, is the current Uncle Tutu about the same height as my father?"
title_en: Chapter 25: In troubled times, people's hearts remain the same Chapter 26: Crossing the river on horseback and returning home in the heart of the moon
